mapper.select: SELECT patient_id AS patientId, id_card_number AS idCardNumber, password, pname, avatar, phone, email, balance FROM patients WHERE id_card_number = #{username}
SELECT patient_id AS patientId, id_card_number AS idCardNumber, password, pname, avatar, phone, email, balance FROM patients WHERE patient_id = #{patientId}
mapper.update: UPDATE patients SET password = #{password}, pname = #{pname}, avatar = #{avatar}, phone = #{phone}, email = #{email}, balance = #{balance} WHERE patient_id = #{patientId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO patients(id_card_number, password, pname, avatar, phone, email, balance) VALUES(#{idCardNumber}, #{password}, #{pname}, NULL, NULL, NULL, 0)
